battle.name: 第二次英國錫克戰爭
battle.theater: 旁遮普穆爾坦與拉合爾
battle.brief: 一八四八年秋，東印度公司對錫克王庭的兼併宣告與通牒迫旁遮普開戰：穆爾坦圍城、阿里瓦爾與加爾詹瓦拉之後，一八四九年三月《拉合爾條約》將旁遮普併入英屬印度。卡面雷管步槍代表當時的底火技術水準，英軍恩菲爾德步槍由法國一八四三年式改良，錫克軍在冬季濃霧中屢屢失手，因火繩槍遇潮難以擊發。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰雙方是東印度公司與錫克帝國（卡爾薩·薩爾卡爾）。英方由英王國駐印度的軍隊與東印度公司的印度軍組成：總督亨利·哈丁治於一八四八年七月到任，孟加拉軍總司令威廉·戈姆中將掌軍制，野戰部隊稱為「蘇特利傑河軍」，由古夫勳爵率領，兵種包括歐洲線列步兵團、孟加拉步兵與輕騎兵、廓爾喀旅、一八四六年成立的旁遮普土著步兵（以錫克族為主）、騎炮兵與攻城砲隊；拉合爾方面設首席政治官一職，掌民政、外交與情報，加爾各答方面維持海運與後勤。錫克方的國家是七歲的杜利普·辛格於一八四八年十一月在拉合爾加冕的旁遮普王庭，攝政權由卡普爾家的賈特首長、攝政官阿吉特·辛格·桑德哈瓦利亞、迪萬·莫蒂·拉姆與古魯·拉姆等瓜分；國家軍隊是卡爾薩軍，包含法伊茲名下的常備步兵團、各土邦與村社徵召的民兵、數量龐大的錫克騎兵，以及數十門青銅滑膛前裝砲組成的炮兵群；穆爾坦由納布穆扎法爾汗率領當地守軍，東北方則是克什米爾土邦主古拉布·辛格，戰中站在英方一側，出兵並控制山道。英方的政治目標自始即為直接兼併旁遮普，錫克方要的是在既有疆界內保住王庭、軍隊與主權。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the East India Company and the Sikh Empire, the Khalsa Sarkar. On the British side the force was built out of the Crown's forces in India together with the Company's Indian armies: Governor-General Sir Henry Hardinge took office in July 1848, Sir William Gomm held the command of the Bengal army, and the field force was styled the Army of the Sutlej under Lord Gough. Its composition included European line infantry regiments, Bengal infantry and light cavalry, Gurkha battalions, the Punjab native infantry raised in 1846 and drawn mostly from Sikhs, horse artillery and a siege train; at Lahore a chief political officer handled civil administration, diplomacy and intelligence, and the Calcutta side kept up the shipping and the supply line. The Sikh state was the Punjab court of the seven-year-old Duleep Singh, crowned at Lahore in November 1848, with the regency divided among the Kapur chieftains, the regent Ajit Singh Sandhanwalia, Diwan Moti Ram and Guru Ram. Its armed forces, the Khalsa army, comprised the standing infantry of the fauj, the levies of the various states and villages, a very large body of Sikh cavalry, and batteries of bronze smoothbore muzzle-loading guns. Multan was held by the Nawab Muzaffar Khan with the local garrison, and in the north-east the Maharaja of Kashmir, Gulab Singh, took the British side, supplying troops and holding the mountain tracks. The British political object from the outset was the outright annexation of the Punjab; the Sikh object was to keep court, army and sovereignty within the existing frontiers.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩端。英方最具決定性者是總督亨利·哈丁治：他在一八四八年三月發出兼併旁遮普的公告，七月到任後親赴前線，把「不兼併不罷休」定為政策，戰後的議和與條約也由他主持。古夫勳爵是蘇特利傑河軍的野戰指揮官，一八四八年秋接掌兵權，一八四九年一月二十八日在阿里瓦爾、二月二十一日在加爾詹瓦拉取勝，戰後受封巴勳爵；威廉·戈姆中將任孟加拉軍總司令；諾特中將以一個師的兵力主持穆爾坦圍城，圍城三個多月裡英軍的主要消耗不是來自敵手，而是酷熱與霍亂。弗雷德里克·羅伯茨當時是第六十四步兵團的少尉，在阿里瓦爾以率小隊馳援與果斷指揮嶄露頭角，後來成為英國陸軍元帥與印度總司令；約翰·勞倫斯任拉合爾首席政治官，一八四八年十二月莫蒂·拉姆遣使求和時由他接洽，戰後成為旁遮普首任首席專員。錫克方：馬哈拉賈沙伊·辛格於一八四八年八月十五日在宮中被攝政官桑德哈瓦利亞槍殺，七歲的杜利普·辛格於十一月八日加冕；其母金德·考爾帶幼主出逃，同年十一月卒於亞丁。攝政核心莫蒂·拉姆與古魯·拉姆主張抵抗，古魯·拉姆在穆爾坦鼓勵守軍死守，戰後被英方拘押；穆爾坦的納布穆扎法爾汗自一八四八年秋起圍攻英軍駐地，最終於一八四九年二月與兩名兒子同被以炮決處決。克什米爾土邦主古拉布·辛格在戰中出兵助英，於一八四九年被英方確認為克什米爾的統治者。錫克軍的野戰指揮權則分散於數位賈特首長與法伊茲資深指揮官之手。
peopleEn: The decisive figures came from both ends of the war. On the British side the most consequential was Governor-General Sir Henry Hardinge: he issued the annexation proclamation for the Punjab in March 1848, took up his post in July, went personally up to the front, made annexation the settled policy of the campaign, and conducted the negotiations and the treaty afterwards. Lord Gough was the field commander of the Army of the Sutlej, assuming command in the autumn of 1848 and winning at Aliwal on 28 January and at Gujranwala on 21 February 1849 before being made a Knight of the Bath. Sir William Gomm commanded the Bengal army, and General Nott took a division to conduct the siege of Multan, where the British losses over three months came less from the enemy than from heat and cholera. Frederick Roberts, then a subaltern in the 64th Foot, first attracted notice at Aliwal for leading small parties to the rescue and for decisive handling of his men; he later became a field marshal and Commander-in-Chief in India. John Lawrence was chief political officer at Lahore, received the emissaries Moti Ram sent to seek terms in December 1848, and afterwards became the first Chief Commissioner of the Punjab. On the Sikh side Maharaja Sher Singh was shot dead in the palace on 15 August 1848 by the regent Sandhanwalia, and the seven-year-old Duleep Singh was crowned on 8 November. The Rani Jind Kaur fled with the child prince and died at Aden in November of the same year. Moti Ram and Guru Ram, at the centre of the regency, favoured resistance, and Guru Ram pressed the Multan garrison to hold out before being taken into custody by the British. Nawab Muzaffar Khan of Multan besieged the British garrison from the autumn of 1848 and in February 1849 was shot from a gun together with two of his sons. Gulab Singh of Kashmir fought on the British side during the campaign and was confirmed in 1849 as the ruler of Kashmir. Command of the Sikh field army itself was divided among a number of Jat chieftains and senior commanders of the fauj.
kits: 卡面這件雷管步槍是法國一八四〇年制式的後膛雷管步槍，口徑約十四點七毫米滑膛，槍管上仍可裝刺刀，是當時唯一能大量裝備給線列步兵的底火步槍；法國在一八四三年再製出膛線與雷管合一的獵槍式步槍，英國隨後的恩菲爾德步槍正是由這一系改進而來，本戰役英軍線列步兵所用的槍械正屬這條譜系。英方各營並不完全整齊：歐洲營配備．五七七英吋雷管步槍，印軍與旁遮普土著步兵多為口徑較大的滑膛槍，近戰火力好而精度次之。錫克軍的槍械新舊混雜，除新式雷管步槍外仍有大量火繩槍與燧發槍，口徑與彈藥互不統一，冬季濃霧中的夜襲常因火藥受潮而不能擊發，這正是錫克軍在這一戰役中屢屢錯失夜戰的技術原因。炮兵是錫克軍的強項：保有數十門青銅滑膛前裝砲，部分帶膛線、射程較遠，但缺乏攻城用的重砲與測量器材；英軍以六磅、九磅野戰炮、二十四磅攻城砲與火箭砲對壘，在數量與射程上佔優，終於在加爾詹瓦拉摧毀錫克炮群。騎兵方面，錫克賴特人數龐大、衝鋒兇猛但缺乏統一射擊紀律；英軍以孟加拉輕騎兵團、騎炮兵與一八四六年德默隆創立、以錫克人與廓爾喀人為主的嚮導團負責偵察與追擊。運輸與補給上，英軍靠牛車、駱駝、舟船與河運維持，拉合爾至穆爾坦約三百二十公里；錫克軍境內糧食不足時則就地徵集。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card is the French service pattern of 1840, a breech-loading percussion musket of about 14.7 mm smoothbore that still carried a bayonet, and the only such arm that could be issued in bulk to line infantry at the time. France followed it in 1843 with a rifle that combined rifling and percussion, and the British Enfield was developed from that line, so the muskets used by British line infantry in this campaign belong to the same family. The British were not uniform across the army: European battalions carried .577 inch percussion rifles, while Indian troops and the Punjab native infantry were mostly armed with larger-bore smoothbores, powerful at close quarters but less accurate. The Sikh arms were a mixture of old and new: besides new percussion muskets they still had large numbers of matchlocks and flintlocks in calibres and ammunition that did not match one another, and night attacks in winter fog often failed for want of dry powder, which is the technical reason the Sikhs so often lost the night action of this campaign. Artillery was the Sikh strength: they kept several dozen bronze smoothbore muzzle-loading guns, some rifled and of longer range, but they had no heavy siege pieces and no proper instruments; the British matched them with six- and nine-pounder field guns, twenty-four-pounder siege guns and rockets, and outnumbered and outranged them until the Sikh batteries were destroyed at Gujranwala. In cavalry the Sikh horsemen were numerous and fierce in attack but without uniform fire discipline, while the British used Bengal light cavalry, horse artillery, and the Guides raised in 1846 by de Meuron, largely Sikhs and Gurkhas, for scouting and pursuit. In transport and supply the British relied on bullock carts, camels, boats and river transport over the roughly 320 kilometres from Lahore to Multan, whereas the Sikhs drew what they needed locally when their own country grew short.
tactics: 英方的戰術公式在這一戰役裡定型：以集中炮兵壓制、步兵縱隊與線列交替、騎兵留作預備的組合取勝。加爾詹瓦拉之戰，英軍先用左翼縱隊與炮兵遮蔽正面，吸住錫克軍主力，再令中央縱隊在突破口插入，將對方陣線縱向切斷，潰散後由騎兵追擊殲滅；阿里瓦爾一役的關鍵則是節制騎兵，任錫克騎兵反覆衝鋒力竭，再以生力軍反衝配合炮火斃其精銳。穆爾坦之役，英軍放棄強攻城砦的正面消耗，改採解圍急行軍：部隊日行數十公里，晝夜兼程穿越錫克控制區，切斷守軍退路，並以攻城砲對城牆與缺口施壓；圍城期間英軍在城下紮營，錫克守軍在城內與外堡之間不斷出擊，攻城方因不熟悉地形而在夜戰中失利。錫克方的部署是把騎兵與炮兵置於設防營地周圍，步兵列於塹壕與寨柵之後，夜間以火繩槍近距離射擊英軍宿營與哨所，白晝則以大股騎兵反覆衝擊英軍縱隊；守城的方法是拖延，等待援軍或政治轉機，一八四八年十二月莫蒂·拉姆的求和使節即在此種期待下出發。另一條戰線在旁遮普山區：賈特首長與村社武裝以游騎隊與伏擊牽制英軍分遣隊，使英軍無法把全部兵力壓向一點，英軍則以廓爾喀旅與嚮導團清剿山區據點。
tacticsEn: The British formula of war was fixed in this campaign: massed artillery to suppress, infantry in column and line used in turn, and cavalry held back as a reserve. At Gujranwala the British covered the front with a flank column and their guns, drew the main weight of the Sikh army forward, and then drove the central column through the breach to cut the enemy line in two, breaking it and leaving the cavalry to pursue and destroy. At Aliwal the decisive point was the restraint of the cavalry: the Sikh horsemen were allowed to charge again and again until their strength was spent, and were then met by fresh squadrons and gun fire that destroyed their best men. At Multan the British gave up frontal attempts on the fort and adopted a relieving march instead, the column covering tens of kilometres a day, moving day and night through country held by the Sikhs to cut the garrison's retreat, while the siege guns worked on the walls and the breaches; the besiegers lay in camp below the city and the garrison kept sorties between the town and the outer work, one night assault by the attackers going badly on unfamiliar ground. The Sikh deployment was to place cavalry and guns around a fortified encampment with infantry behind trenches and palisades, to shoot British encampments and pickets at close range with matchlocks by night, and to charge the British columns repeatedly with masses of horsemen by day; their method in the siege was to hold on, waiting for relief or a political turn, and the emissaries Moti Ram sent in December 1848 set out on exactly that expectation. A second front ran in the Sikh hills, where Jat chieftains and village bands used mounted patrols and ambushes to pin down British detachments and keep the British from concentrating everything on one point, the British replying with Gurkha battalions and the Guides clearing the hill posts.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：戰爭自一八四八年十一月五日的穆扎法爾納加爾戰起，至一八四九年三月英軍進入拉合爾、三月二十九日簽訂《拉合爾條約》，正面作戰約四個半月。英軍蘇特利傑河軍在高峰時約一萬八千人，含歐洲營、廓爾喀旅與旁遮普土著步兵；加爾詹瓦拉一役英軍出動約一萬人、配野戰炮約六十門，錫克軍的常見估計是三萬人上下（史料從二萬五千至四萬不等），其中騎兵逾一萬；加爾詹瓦拉一役之後，英軍收繳錫克火炮近九十門。穆爾坦之役，攻城部隊約九千人，據當時英軍記錄，圍城三個多月裡陣亡逾八百人、病倒逾五千人，多屬酷熱與疫病所致；為解穆爾坦之圍所作的強行軍約二百五十公里，歷時約十六日，途中大量掉隊。路徑上，拉合爾至穆爾坦約三百二十公里，穆爾坦至阿里瓦爾約六十公里。整場戰爭英軍陣亡約千人上下、受傷人數數倍於此，錫克軍的陣亡與被俘合計以數千計，數倍於英方。戰後杜利普·辛格由英國政府按年支付四萬英鎊年金，旁遮普全境土地約二十五萬平方公里。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war ran from the fighting at Muzaffarnagar on 5 November 1848 to the British entry into Lahore in March 1849 and the Treaty of Lahore of 29 March, with about four and a half months of hard fighting. The Army of the Sutlej numbered some eighteen thousand men at its height, including European battalions, Gurkhas and the Punjab native infantry; at Gujranwala the British fielded about ten thousand men with roughly sixty field guns, while the Sikh army is commonly estimated at around thirty thousand, the estimates ranging from twenty-five to forty thousand, with more than ten thousand of them cavalry; after Gujranwala the British took some ninety Sikh guns. At Multan the besieging force was about nine thousand strong, and the British records of the siege show more than eight hundred dead and over five thousand sick over three months, most of it from heat and disease; the forced march made to relieve Multan covered about 250 kilometres in some sixteen days, with heavy straggling on the way. On the ground, Lahore lies about 320 kilometres from Multan and Aliwal about 60 kilometres from it. Over the whole war the British lost about a thousand dead with several times that number wounded, while Sikh dead and prisoners together were counted in the thousands, several times the British figure. After the war the British government paid Duleep Singh an annuity of forty thousand pounds a year, and the annexed territory of the Punjab covered some 250,000 square kilometres.
cause: 起因是多層的。第一層是第一次英國錫克戰爭留下的懸案：一八四六年《拉合爾條約》之後，錫克王庭仍完整統治旁遮普，英國在該地只能派駐一名代表，無權過問軍隊與司法，倫敦視此為西北方向上一個不受約束的軍國。第二層是國際形勢：第一次鴉片戰爭之後，英方擔心錫克王庭會趁中央亞細亞局勢變動而與俄國接觸，因此需要一個能直接控制的邊界。第三層是主權摩擦：一八四六年以後英軍以追討逃犯與邊境稅務為由進入錫克山區據點，錫克方面視之為侵犯；駐旁遮普的英國代表要求擴大權限、限制錫克軍隊對邊防的壟斷，攝政方則堅持王庭的傳統權力，衝突步步升高。一八四八年三月，哈丁治發出兼併旁遮普的公告，廢除英國代表在「雙重政府」中的位置，並要求錫克軍隊全部退回蘇特利傑河以南，以奧托克要塞交換英方駐軍；同年六月，錫克攝政解僱英軍軍官、驅逐英國代表出拉合爾，英方隨即下達最後通牒並進軍丘陵與要塞。局勢又因一八四八年八月十五日沙伊·辛格遇刺、十一月杜利普·辛格加冕而更加混亂：攝政內部有主戰與主和兩派，莫蒂·拉姆的使節於十二月抵達拉合爾求和時，英方已認定只有兼併才能解決問題，談判遂告破裂。直接引爆戰事的，是一八四八年十月錫克軍進攻穆爾坦的英軍駐地。
causeEn: The causes ran in several layers. The first was the unfinished business left by the First Anglo-Sikh War: after the Treaty of Lahore of 1846 the Sikh court still ruled the Punjab in full, Britain could keep only a single resident there and had no voice over the army or the courts, and London regarded an unconstrained military state on the north-west frontier as a standing danger. The second was the international situation: after the First Opium War the British feared that the Sikh court might make contact with Russia as the situation in Central Asia shifted, and they wanted a frontier they could control directly. The third was friction over sovereignty: from 1846 the British entered Sikh hill posts in pursuit of fugitives and over frontier dues, which the Sikhs treated as a violation; the British resident at Lahore pressed for wider powers and for an end to the Sikh monopolies over the frontier, while the regency insisted on the traditional authority of the court, and the quarrel grew step by step. In March 1848 Hardinge proclaimed the annexation of the Punjab, abolished the resident's place in the double government, and required the Sikh army to fall back south of the Sutlej in exchange for the British garrison at Attock; in June the Sikh regency dismissed British officers and expelled the residents from Lahore, and the British followed with an ultimatum and an advance into the hills and forts. The situation was made worse by the assassination of Sher Singh on 15 August 1848 and the coronation of Duleep Singh in November: the regency split between war and negotiation, and when Moti Ram's envoys reached Lahore in December seeking terms, the British had already concluded that only annexation would settle the question, so the talks broke down. What lit the fuse was the Sikh attack on the British garrison at Multan in October 1848.
impact: 影響深遠而具體。政治上，旁遮普併入東印度公司，錫克王國終結：杜利普·辛格被帶往英國，此後以「最後的錫克王」身份在英格蘭與法國生活，一八五〇年將科伊諾爾鑽石交出，由英國女王維多利亞收藏，幼年王室的象徵自此離開印度。英國對印度王公的地位隨之步步取消，一八五三年起以「無嗣土封還論」兼併薩塔拉、占西與那格浦爾，制度上為一八五七年之前的領土兼併鋪平道路。軍事與人口上，旁遮普成為英軍兵源與糧源的重心：以錫克族編成的多個團（第一、第五及第一錫克團與其後設立的第五至第十一錫克團）成為英軍骨幹，其中多個營在印度起義中站在英方，錫克士兵與旁遮普的關係由對抗轉為制度化的從軍。經濟上，拉合爾至穆爾坦一線的運河與鐵路把原本的邊地變成農業與運輸出產區，形成所謂運河殖民地，約翰·勞倫斯以首席專員身份主持土地整理、治安重整與鐵路勘線，之後數十年旁遮普的產出佔英屬印度農業總值相當大的比重。戰術上，這是歐洲式炮兵與線列步兵在印度第一次大規模交鋒並勝出的案例，確立了英軍「炮兵優先、騎兵預備、步兵縱隊穿透」的公式，後來在克里米亞與一八五七年的戰事中被反覆引用。制度上，一八四九年戰後的非常措施與東印度公司的權力擴張，促成一八五四年《東印度公司治理法》取代公司統治，設立印度部與印度總督；一八五六年旁遮普正式設省。
impactEn: The consequences were far-reaching and concrete. Politically the Punjab was annexed to the East India Company and the Sikh state came to an end: Duleep Singh was taken to Britain and lived there and in France as the last Sikh maharaja, handing over the Koh-i-Noor in 1850 for the collection of Queen Victoria, and the emblem of the boy court left India for good. The standing of the Indian princely states was then whittled away, and from 1853 the doctrine of lapse brought in Satara, Jhansi and Nagpur, preparing the ground for the annexations that preceded 1857. Militarily and demographically the Punjab became the hinge of British recruitment and supply: the Sikh regiments, among them the 1st, 5th and 6th to 11th Sikhs, became a core of the army, and several of their battalions stood with the British during the Indian rising, so that the relation between Sikh soldiers and the Punjab changed from opposition to institutionalised service. Economically the canals and the railway along the Lahore-Multan line turned what had been a frontier into an agricultural and transport producing region, the canal colonies, and John Lawrence, as Chief Commissioner, directed the land settlement, the policing and the surveying of the railway line; for decades afterwards the Punjab accounted for a very large share of the agricultural output of British India. Tactically this was the first large-scale meeting in India between European-style artillery and line infantry, and it confirmed the British formula of artillery first, cavalry in reserve, infantry column breaking through, a formula cited again and again in the Crimea and in 1857. Institutionally the emergency measures of 1849 and the widening of the Company's authority led to the Government of India Act of 1854, which replaced Company rule with a Board of India and a Viceroy; the Punjab became a separate province in 1856.
result: 英軍在戰場上贏得三場決定性戰鬥：一八四九年一月二十二日的穆爾坦解圍、一月二十八日的阿里瓦爾與二月二十一日的加爾詹瓦拉；此後錫克野戰軍在平原上瓦解，殘部退入山區，以游騎隊與游擊的方式繼續抵抗。一八四九年三月英軍進入拉合爾；三月二十九日《拉合爾條約》確定結局，杜利普·辛格放棄主權，錫克王國併入東印度公司，英方承諾按年支付四萬英鎊年金，錫克王室的印璽、軍械庫與城防移交新政府。穆爾坦的穆扎法爾汗在城砦淪陷後於一八四九年二月與兩名兒子同被以炮決處決，穆爾坦這片富庶的農業區亦落入英方控制。戰後至一八四九年底與一八五○年，殘餘武裝被逐一肅清；克什米爾土邦主古拉布·辛格在英方支持下被確認為克什米爾的土邦王。整體而言，這是一場以「兼併」而不是以劃定邊界為目標的戰爭：英軍在戰場上的優勢來自雷管步槍與制式炮兵所帶來的射擊精度、射程與射速差距，加上組織與補給線；錫克軍則敗於指揮不統一與缺乏外援。帳面結算：錫克帝國從此不再存在，旁遮普的領土與軍隊併入東印度公司，並以行省與兵源地的新身分留在英國秩序之中。
resultEn: The result was that British arms won the three decisive actions of the campaign: the relief of Multan on 22 January 1849, Aliwal on 28 January, and Gujranwala on 21 February. After that the Sikh field army broke up on the plains and what was left of it fell back into the hills to carry on the war as mounted patrols and ambushes. In March 1849 the British entered Lahore; the Treaty of Lahore of 29 March settled the outcome, Duleep Singh renounced sovereignty, the Sikh state was incorporated into the East India Company, the British promised an annuity of forty thousand pounds a year, and the regalia, the arsenals and the forts of the Sikh court passed to the new administration. Muzaffar Khan of Multan was shot from a gun in February 1849 together with two of his sons after the fortress had fallen, and the fertile districts of Multan came under British control. The last bands of resistance were run down through the end of 1849 and 1850, and Gulab Singh was confirmed as the Maharaja of Kashmir with British support. The war was fought with annexation rather than a settled frontier as its object, and the British advantage on the field came from the contrast in accuracy, range and rate of fire that percussion muskets and service artillery gave them, together with organisation and supply, while the Sikh army failed for want of unified command and outside support. The account closes: the Sikh Empire ceased to exist, its territory and its forces passed to the Company, and the Punjab entered the British order as both a province and a recruiting ground.
